text: I feel an invigorating sense of curiosity here. The modern, glass-walled room gives an impression of transparency and openness, while the R+D exhibit beyond the door calls to something deeper in me—a longing to think, to innovate. In this bright, well-designed space, I sense both clarity and anticipation. I experience a gentle tension between the discipline of research and the creative potential of development, wondering about the possibilities they offer. To be in this environment is to navigate the edge between the known and the unknown, and I embrace it with thoughtful excitement.
